From c17c3dc9d08b9aad9a55a1e53f205187972f448e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Hugh Dickins <hughd@google.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2020 17:42:17 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] uprobes: __replace_page() avoid BUG in munlock_vma_page()

syzbot crashed on the VM_BUG_ON_PAGE(PageTail) in munlock_vma_page(), when
called from uprobes __replace_page().  Which of many ways to fix it?
Settled on not calling when PageCompound (since Head and Tail are equals
in this context, PageCompound the usual check in uprobes.c, and the prior
use of FOLL_SPLIT_PMD will have cleared PageMlocked already).

Fixes: 5a52c9df62b4 ("uprobe: use FOLL_SPLIT_PMD instead of FOLL_SPLIT")
Reported-by: syzbot <syzkaller@googlegroups.com>
Signed-off-by: Hugh Dickins <hughd@google.com>
Signed-off-by: Andrew Morton <akpm@linux-foundation.org>
Reviewed-by: Srikar Dronamraju <srikar@linux.vnet.ibm.com>
Acked-by: Song Liu <songliubraving@fb.com>
Acked-by: Oleg Nesterov <oleg@redhat.com>
Cc: "Kirill A. Shutemov" <kirill.shutemov@linux.intel.com>
Cc: <stable@vger.kernel.org>	[5.4+]
Link: http://lkml.kernel.org/r/alpine.LSU.2.11.2008161338360.20413@eggly.anvils
Signed-off-by: Linus Torvalds <torvalds@linux-foundation.org>

diff --git a/kernel/events/uprobes.c b/kernel/events/uprobes.c
index 649fd53dc9ad..0e18aaf23a7b 100644
--- a/kernel/events/uprobes.c
+++ b/kernel/events/uprobes.c
@@ -205,7 +205,7 @@ static int __replace_page(struct vm_area_struct *vma, unsigned long addr,
 		try_to_free_swap(old_page);
 	page_vma_mapped_walk_done(&pvmw);
 
-	if (vma->vm_flags & VM_LOCKED)
+	if ((vma->vm_flags & VM_LOCKED) && !PageCompound(old_page))
 		munlock_vma_page(old_page);
 	put_page(old_page);
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `kernel/events/uprobes.c`**
   - **Modification**: The condition for calling `munlock_vma_page(old_page)` has been changed. The original line:
     ```c
     if (vma->vm_flags & VM_LOCKED)
     ```
     has been modified to:
     ```c
     if ((vma->vm_flags & VM_LOCKED) && !PageCompound(old_page))
     ```
   - **Effect**: This change ensures that `munlock_vma_page()` is only called if the `VM_LOCKED` flag is set and the `old_page` is not a compound page. This prevents the `VM_BUG_ON_PAGE(PageTail)` error that was occurring when `munlock_vma_page()` was called on compound pages.

### Relationships

- The modification in `uprobes.c` directly addresses a bug reported by syzbot, which was triggered by the previous implementation that did not account for compound pages. The change is a safeguard to prevent the bug from occurring by ensuring that the `munlock_vma_page()` function is not called on pages that are compound, thus maintaining the integrity of the virtual memory area management. This fix is related to a prior change (identified by the commit hash `5a52c9df62b4`) that introduced the use of `FOLL_SPLIT_PMD`, which had implications for how pages were managed in the uprobes context.

You are a programming expert.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
if (vma->vm_flags & VM_LOCKED)
    munlock_vma_page(old_page);
```
Reason:
The bug occurs because the `munlock_vma_page()` function is called without checking if `old_page` is a compound page. If `old_page` is a tail page of a compound page, this leads to an assertion failure (`VM_BUG_ON_PAGE(PageTail)`) in `munlock_vma_page()`, as it is not valid to unlock a tail page.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if ((vma->vm_flags & VM_LOCKED) && !PageCompound(old_page))
    munlock_vma_page(old_page);
```
Reason:
The fix adds a check to ensure that `munlock_vma_page()` is only called if `old_page` is not a compound page. This prevents the assertion failure by ensuring that the function is only called on valid pages, thus avoiding the invalid operation on tail pages of compound pages.
